"} free text (h2, h3, p, ul, ol, li, strong, em, a, blockquote). {"type":"image","mediaIds":[ids],"view":..,"aspect":..,"fit":..} up to 12 screenshots; view plain, slides, carousel, laptop, iphone, android or tablet; aspect 16:9 (default), 16:10, 4:3, 1:1, 4:5 or 9:16 for plain, slides and carousel; fit cover (fills, may crop) or contain (whole image). {"type":"clip","mediaId":id,"view":..,"playback":"autoplay"|"click"} your preview clip, at most once; view plain, laptop, iphone, android or tablet; autoplay plays muted when it scrolls into view, click shows a play button. Without a clip block the clip plays at the top of the page. {"type":"video","youtubeId":"","view":..} a YouTube video, loaded only after a click. Media ids come from get_product_page; unknown ids are refused and nothing is saved. Screenshots in no image block show under "More screenshots" at the end. At most 40 blocks. On a software that is already on sale, changed text (text blocks) waits for review before visitors see it (the response has changes_pending_review); images, clip, video and layout go live at once. Read get_product_page afterwards: warnings should be empty. Requires CRELA_API_KEY.
